text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I underestimated how much work being
your partner would be. Just
look at all this
attention I'm drawing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I think you understood it well
enough. You saw that the appeal
of my
offer was bigger than the risks involved.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promise to fulfill my end of the deal. And
these lessons until the
Droit won't
interfere with your training, so you can rest
assured.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then! We've shown each other our
costumes, so let's see how we
feel in them
and practice our dancing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll start by accustoming ourselves
to the partner dance.
Normal classroom
lessons only focus on winning concert
performances.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But what's different from regular dancing
is, of course, that we'll be
doing it with a
partner. There's something especially
important about
that... Do you know what
it is?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Making sure not to step on each
other's tails?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, well, you're not wrong! More
specifically, we have to learn to
breathe in
time with one another.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For now, that's all you need to worry
about. I'll take the lead. I have a
routine in
mind too—ready to try?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four... One, two, three,
four...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, can you lean on me a little more?
That's it... Just trust me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Come now, Sky.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That was excellent! I knew you'd be a fast
learner. What else... I think
you'll be able
to move more easily once you trust me
more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Are we doing this choreography during the real thing? The dance and the song are just so classical.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What we'll be doing is the exhibition. Our
job is to create a fun
atmosphere before
everyone else starts dancing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Normally the dorm leaders show an
example for everyone to follow...
A
glamorous waltz always gets everybody in
a cheerful mood.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohh, so that's why.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uh! Nothin'...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sky, come on, we need to be in sync.
Want to try finishing your
thought?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Really, it's nothing important. Just, you
know... it feels kinda
ordinary...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Go on.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely got a vibrant party feel, and
it's a perfect way to
highlight you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But... well, I don't know anything about
the Droit. It's probably better
to just do it
how you want.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...All right. What can we do to make it
more interesting?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ohh, I'm not the expert here. What
would I know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe put in a lift? I could try holding
you up and turning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that really feels like you, I guess.
But maybe we don't need to
worry about
making it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Then what if we did a turn and really nailed it? Turning speed, angle—perfectly in tune.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Um... Actually, what if we don't match each other?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like this—we could start off doing
completely different movements,
throwing
the audience for a loop, then click
together at just the right
moment... or
something.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's no way we'll be perfectly in sync
with the time we have left,
so might as well
show 'em a little surprise instead, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Well, I mean, easier said than done,
right? Now that we've tried
a little, I can
tell my movements really aren't up to par.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And the whole trusting you part... I haven't
gotten the hang of that
either. Better to
not try anything crazy. We should just
focus on the
basics and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ack!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, is that from Spe and the others?
This is great.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Was this your idea? I knew I
wouldn't be able to hide being in
the
Droit, but still...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: People are getting way too excited, or mad for some reason, or giving me wrestling masks? Not to mention...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So your plan was to get everyone excited
to see me and cut off my
retreat, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There's no plan! It's all because you're so popular. And how would I know the key to motivating you was your friends?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha. So, is everyone coming to the Droit?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to say, but yep, they're all comin'...
Can't believe I invited all my
classmates.
This isn't some festival.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So they're coming... That's great.
